items.q: What kind of model is Jev, on this tape?
items.a: A **decision bot**. State in, questions out, in parallel. Choice, score, and a **0–1** he calls a nual. It will not write quicksort. The manifesto line is **build prod not God**.

items.q: Where does he show it in a loop?
items.a: Smash Bros. chat for **2,000 people** and four characters. A slow agent took **a minute and a half**. Balatro wins about **30%** of runs. Doom is dodge-or-not and fire-or-not **at the same time**.
Input tokens only. One Smash question was **345 tokens**, about **3 million calls for $44**. An urgent-email branch is about **100 ms** and **$42 per billion tokens**.
